setup.title: Unit K7 and the Golden Crack
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, a gentle futuristic city with misty blue mornings and warm craft workshops.

cast.name: Unit K7
cast.description: Unit K7, a small knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head, two glowing blue eyes, a hairline crack over its right eye, two brass antennae, and an orange canvas satchel worn across its body.

extras.voice: Unit K7, a small robot with a soft, slightly synthetic childlike voice, a gentle curious pace and a warm tone (S1),
extras.music: Delicate music-box melody with soft strings and a light glockenspiel, kept at low volume throughout.
extras.speech: K7 speaks only a few short, curious sentences to itself.

shots.prompt:
A wide, gently futuristic city plaza stretches under a cool, misty morning sky. Pale blue fog hangs low between sleek architectural towers, softening distant holographic signs and storefront illuminations into diffuse pastel glows of amber and cyan. The dark paving stones are slick with moisture, mirroring the hazy lights in long, glossy reflections. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful, enveloped in cool, damp air as the waking city stirs in the soft light.

Unit K7, a small, knee-high robot made of smooth cream ceramic, journeys across the wet plaza tiles. The automaton features a round head with two glowing circular blue eyes, two thin brass antennae, and a distinct hairline crack over its right eye. A small, empty orange canvas satchel hangs across its torso by a diagonal strap. Unit K7 waddles steadily across the damp stones, its little feet pattering against the ground while the orange satchel bobs against its ceramic flank. The brass antennae vibrate faintly with each step, and the hairline crack over its luminous right eye remains visible as it moves forward without stopping.

The camera tracks smoothly in a wide shot, positioned at a low angle just above the damp pavement. This framing accentuates Unit K7’s modest stature against the vast, towering backdrop of the foggy plaza. The reflective ground, the gentle sway of the satchel, and the hazy glowing signs in the distance remain visible throughout the shot, presenting a grounded, documentary-style record of the robot's morning journey.

annotation.beat: Morning in a wet futuristic plaza with glowing signs. Unit K7 waddles across the reflective pavement, satchel bouncing, the hairline crack visible over its right eye.

state.body_condition: cream ceramic with a hairline crack over the right eye

shots.prompt:
The morning plaza remains slick and damp, its dark pavement reflecting muted turquoise and pale blue light from distant city fixtures. Cool, dewy air hangs low to the ground, where shallow puddles gather beside a raised stone curb. Embedded in the walkway, a circular metal utility grate sits flush with the paving stones, venting faint wisps of heat into the chilled dawn atmosphere before building sudden pressure.

Unit K7 waddles forward, standing knee-high with smooth cream ceramic plating, two glowing circular blue eyes, and two slender brass antennae atop its round head. A faint hairline crack sits above its right eye, and an empty orange canvas satchel hangs across its torso. Just as it approaches the curb, a violent plume of white steam erupts straight from the floor grate, instantly engulfing the small robot in dense fog. When the swirling vapor quickly disperses, K7 is sprawled on the wet paving stones, having tripped over the curb during the blast. The impact has damaged its casing: the hairline crack has split into a prominent, jagged fracture cutting across its face plate, while its blue optical sensors dim slightly in shock.

The camera maintains a low-angle medium shot, keeping K7, the vent, and the curb centered in frame. The lens remains steady as the steam explodes and drifts away, ensuring the robot's fall and resulting damage are plainly legible. The newly widened, dark crack stands out sharply against the pale cream ceramic face plate on the glistening, wet ground.

annotation.beat: A white steam cloud bursts from a vent and swallows K7; when it clears, K7 has tripped over a curb and fallen, and the crack has widened into a jagged split across its face plate.

state.body_condition: jagged widened crack across the face plate

shots.prompt:
The wet urban plaza stretches out under a cool, misty morning light that washes the scene in muted blues and slate greys. Smooth paving stones glisten with moisture, pooling shallow rainwater into clear puddles that mirror the pale futuristic sky above. Soft atmospheric fog drifts along the ground, lending a quiet, contemplative mood to the open pedestrian space.

Unit K7, a knee-high cream ceramic robot with two slender brass antennae and an empty orange canvas satchel across its chest, sits upright on the damp pavers. Across its smooth round face plate, a jagged widened crack is prominently visible. K7 lowers its gaze toward a shallow puddle, where a small curved ceramic shard lies in the water. Its glowing blue eyes dim and flicker with a faint, sorrowful tremor. Tilting forward, the robot carefully reaches out with its ceramic hand, pinches the wet fragment, and lifts it from the puddle. Above K7’s right eye, a corresponding small chip is now plainly absent at the edge of the fracture. Moving deliberately, K7 opens the orange satchel flap, places the recovered shard inside, and seals it shut.

The close-up camera remains low to the glistening ground, holding a tight focus on K7’s cracked head, expressive flickering eyes, and hands. A subtle downward tilt follows the retrieval of the shard from the puddle before resting level as the piece enters the satchel, maintaining crisp clarity on the robot's damaged porcelain-like shell throughout the shot.

annotation.beat: K7 sits up and finds a small curved ceramic shard broken off its head lying in a puddle. It picks the shard up carefully and puts it in its orange satchel, eyes flickering sadly.

state.body_condition: missing a small chip above the right eye, jagged crack

shots.prompt:
A bustling covered market street stretches beneath an arched glass canopy, where cool morning mist filters through to mix with the golden glow of hanging paper lanterns. Rows of wooden artisan stalls display handcrafted goods, pottery, and woven textiles, bathed in amber lamplight that reflects softly off damp paving stones. The atmosphere is quiet yet lively, filled with the gentle presence of shoppers and drifting steam rising into the cool blue morning shadows of the corridor.

Unit K7, a knee-high robot crafted from smooth cream ceramic, walks steadily along the flagstones. It features a round head, two glowing blue eyes, and thin brass antennae, though a jagged crack runs over its right eye where a small ceramic chip is visibly missing. An orange canvas satchel, holding the broken shard inside, hangs diagonally across its torso. K7 toddles forward with small, measured steps, constantly tilting its round head upward to scan the suspended wooden signs. Navigating carefully around market baskets and passing legs, the small automaton gradually slows to a halt as its blue gaze locks onto a small hanging sign painted with an illustration of a golden bowl.

The camera moves in a smooth, low-angle tracking shot, retreating backward just above pavement level to match K7's walking pace. The framing keeps the compact robot centered in full view, emphasizing its diminutive scale against the bustling market and tall stall posts. As K7 stops, the camera eases to a rest and tilts slightly upward, keeping K7's uplifted face and the illuminated sign framed together in the warm ambient light.

annotation.beat: K7 walks through a busy covered market street of lantern-lit stalls, looking up at signs until it spots a small sign with a golden bowl painted on it.

shots.prompt:
The interior of the kintsugi workshop glows with soft amber light spilling from hanging paper lanterns and small workbench lamps. Natural cedar paneling wraps the walls, lined with shelves displaying dozens of repaired ceramic vessels joined by gleaming seams of polished gold. Worktables are organized with horsehair brushes, jars of natural lacquer, and dusting powders. The atmosphere is quiet, contemplative, and still, carrying the faint, earthy scent of cured resin and aged wood.

At the threshold, Unit K7, a knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head, glowing blue eyes, two brass antennae, and an orange canvas satchel worn across its body, pushes open the slatted wooden sliding door. A jagged crack with a missing chip is clearly visible above its right eye. K7 steps quietly onto the timber floorboards. Across the room, an elderly craftswoman with silver hair pinned in a neat bun, wearing an indigo apron over a work shirt, looks up from her bench. Setting down a fine tool, she smiles warmly at the small visitor.

The camera holds in a steady medium wide shot, framing both the entrance and the artisan's workstation in balanced view. The composition stays stationary at a low-neutral height, preserving K7’s modest stature alongside the seated craftswoman. Soft lighting catches the golden seams of pottery resting on the background shelves, keeping the entire interaction quiet and intimate.

annotation.beat: K7 pushes open the sliding door of a warm wooden workshop full of repaired bowls with gold seams. An old craftswoman with silver hair in a bun and an indigo apron looks up from her bench and smiles.

shots.prompt:

annotation.beat: With a fine brush the craftswoman fills the crack with dark urushi lacquer and sets the shard back into place; K7 sits very still on the bench, eyes dimmed.

shots.prompt:
The kintsugi workshop is quiet and filled with warm afternoon sunlight, creating a tranquil, intimate atmosphere. Amber rays cut across the wooden workbench, catching minute motes in the air. The surrounding space blurs into soft, out-of-focus wood tones and ceramic pottery, directing complete visual attention to the delicate craftsmanship unfolding on the table.

Unit K7, the small knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head and glowing blue eyes, sits perfectly still. Its brass antennae catch the light, an empty orange canvas satchel rests across its chest, and the fracture above its right eye is filled with dark, tacky lacquer. An artisan's hand enters the frame holding a slender, soft-tipped brush dusted with fine gold powder. With slow, precise sweeps, she dusts the powder directly onto the dark seam. The shimmering grains instantly adhere to the wet lacquer, turning the dark fissure into an intricate ribbon of lustrous gold. K7 remains motionless as the transformation unfolds. By the end of the shot, the formerly dark crack across its face has become a brilliant, shining golden kintsugi seam gleaming cleanly against the cream ceramic.

The macro close-up holds an extremely shallow depth of field, focused tightly on K7's right eye and brow. The camera tracks with a slow, almost imperceptible drift downward alongside the brush's path. K7's soft blue eye glow, the brush bristles, and the newly radiant golden line stay crisply in focus throughout the movement.

annotation.beat: The craftswoman dusts fine gold powder along the lacquered seam with a soft brush; the crack becomes a shining golden line across K7's face.

shots.prompt:
The scene unfolds on an open rooftop garden overlooking a gentle futuristic city beneath a serene dusk. A deep purple and rose-colored sky casts soft, diffused evening light across the weathered stone terrace. Lush potted ferns, flowering shrubs, and trailing ivy crowd the edges, creating a quiet botanical haven high above the streets. The atmosphere is peaceful and cool, with gentle evening air rustling the leaves against the distant skyline.

Unit K7, a small knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head and glowing blue eyes, enters the terrace. A prominent golden kintsugi seam repairs the crack over its right eye, a bright red ribbon flutters from one brass antenna, and an orange canvas satchel hangs across its torso. K7 steps carefully between the terracotta planters toward a flat stone ledge. It reaches into its satchel, lifts out a delicate teacup, and places it upright onto the ledge. By the end of the action, the teacup rests securely on the stone, leaving the satchel empty and flat against K7's ceramic flank as its blue eyes glow steadily in contemplation.

The camera holds a wide, static shot at mid-terrace level, framing K7's small stature against the sprawling plants and the vast purple sky. The wide composition keeps the robot, the ledge, and the teacup in clear view without cutting or pushing in, allowing the gentle placement to anchor the quiet moment.

annotation.beat: K7 climbs onto a rooftop garden full of potted plants under a purple dusk sky and carefully sets the teacup on a ledge.

shots.prompt:

Fine raindrops patter softly against broad green foliage and dark, damp soil in weathered terracotta planters. Unit K7, a small knee-high cream ceramic robot, kneels beside a planter. The focus stays crisp on K7's ceramic fingers, the shimmering golden kintsugi line, and the emerging sprout, while the rain-slicked rooftop foliage softens into a blurred, dusky purple background.

shots.prompt:
Pale morning light spills across the wide, wet plaza of the futuristic city, illuminating sleek stone flagstones damp with early dew. A soft blue mist hangs low across the expansive square, diffusing the gentle silhouettes of curved buildings in the distant background. Faint reflections of the cool sky shimmer on the ground, while a round metal steam vent set into the pavement quietly hums, releasing thin tendrils of vapor into the brisk, tranquil atmosphere.

Unit K7, a knee-high cream ceramic robot with a smooth round head, two glowing blue eyes, and twin brass antennae, walks steadily across the wet surface. A bright red ribbon is neatly tied to the base of its left antenna, and its orange canvas satchel hangs flat and empty against its torso. Across the ceramic over its right eye, an intricate golden kintsugi seam glints warmly under the daylight. As K7 advances, the ground grate suddenly releases a burst of dense, hissing white steam that plumes upward into its walking path. K7 pauses for a fraction of a second, adjusts its footing, and smoothly arcs around the cloud of vapor. The gleaming golden line across its face catches the morning sun as it steps past the vent and resumes its steady stride.

The camera moves alongside in a low-angle wide tracking shot, traveling parallel to K7 at ground level. The wide perspective maintains K7's full body in view against the open expanse, clearly showing the steam vent erupting and the small robot successfully circling the plume before continuing into the foggy distance.

annotation.beat: The next morning K7 crosses the same foggy plaza from the first shot; the steam vent bursts again, and this time K7 steps around it, golden seam gleaming.
